mapper.insert: insert into task_file ( task_no, attach_no, task_file_ctime ) values ( #{taskNo}, #{attachNo}, systimestamp )
mapper.select: select a.attach_no as attachNo, a.attach_name as attachName, a.attach_type as attachType, a.attach_size as attachSize, tf.task_file_ctime as ctime from task_file tf inner join attach a on tf.attach_no = a.attach_no where tf.task_no = #{taskNo} order by tf.task_file_ctime asc
mapper.insert: insert into task_comment_file ( task_comment_no, attach_no, task_comment_file_ctime ) values ( #{taskCommentNo}, #{attachNo}, systimestamp )
mapper.select: select a.attach_no as attachNo, a.attach_name as attachName, a.attach_type as attachType, a.attach_size as attachSize, tcf.task_comment_file_ctime as ctime from task_comment_file tcf inner join attach a on tcf.attach_no = a.attach_no where tcf.task_comment_no = #{taskCommentNo} order by tcf.task_comment_file_ctime asc
